_README: Vendored HASSH-to-tooling lookup. Resolved against each IP's dominant
HASSH at rollup time (see _build_ip_doc); the result is stamped onto
the IP rollup as `hassh_family` + `hassh_tool` for analyst display.
tool:       specific tool/library/version if known (free-form string)
source:     URL or short citation supporting the attribution
Adding entries: edit this file, then either:
(a) clear the per-IP rollup watermark + re-run `rollup ips` to backfill, or
(b) just wait — new sessions on existing IPs re-roll naturally.
Removing entries: same as above; absence stamps null and the console
stops surfacing the chip on next page load.
Empty `entries` is intentional and safe: the lookup is a clean no-op,
no field is stamped, and the console hides the chip. Curate per-corpus.
(7.4) to find your top cluster IDs, then resolve each one's dominant HASSH
via the IP rollup and add an entry here.
